Results.ReviewText: This is my second Weber. I received it as a present. I love the grill and the various accessories are great. The changes made from my first grill to the second are very useful.
Results.Title: Love my grill

Results.ReviewText: I love Weber grill!!! Easy to assemble, is very sturdy, looks great and cooks well!!!!
Results.Title: Very Nice Charcoal Grill!!!

Results.ReviewText: The gold standard in charcoal grilling! I have used Weber grills my entire life and will continue to do so. They are very durable and last years. If you do need to replace a part, they are super easy to find and change out. Weber customer service is amazing if you ever have questions or run into any issues. Highly suggest the premium model with the ash catcher! Makes life so much easier (and cleaner) in the long run.
Results.Title: Amazing Grill!

Results.ReviewText: We've had a 22" Weber for over 17 years and I knew it was starting to show wear.  I didn't realize how much until I really cleaned the bowl.  Then the problems shined through all over.  Got a new one and am amazed at how great it cooks.  Uses less charcoal and stays hot.
Results.Title: Great cooking on a 22" Weber

Results.ReviewText: This is a great product and very good customer service. The best!
Results.Title: Best BBQ grill!

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your comments and feedback regarding the thermometer. Our thermometer has a hole in the back to allow condensation and moisture to dissipate. We have reached out via email to discuss this further with you. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: I like every feature about the grill except the thermometer.  For some reason someone decided to not make it water proof.  Having it trap water on something that is used outside is a silly oversight.  It isn't even water resistant.
Results.Title: Nice grill but thermometer is not waterproof

Results.ReviewText: Awesome Grill! There’s a reason for Weber’s long standing name in the industry. Does what it’s supposed to and looks good doing it!
Results.Title: Very happy!!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned my Weber grill for years and it is still works great . Have told many friends and they have switched . Will be buying my second one next year just because we know grill out more than we use the stove . It breaks down easily also I have moved 5 times in the states and has survived.
Results.Title: AMAZING

Results.ReviewText: You can't beat the results.  It's the flavor king for meat and there's endless charcoal and smoke types to play with.   These have the best metal coating ever.  Mine sits in the rain all year and has no issues.  It's lightweight enough - I can dump it out if need be or put it in the truck whenever I go somewhere fun.   If mine ever breaks, I'll immediately get another one or two.
Results.Title: I've had mine 6 or 7 years now

Results.ReviewText: This is an amazing all round grill!! You can smoke and grill like a pro!! Very durable and easy to maintain
Results.Title: Great Grill!!

Results.ReviewText: Everything has been great with the exception of the big dent/scratches it arrived with fresh out of the box. It makes the lid a little tough to get on completely but it still works.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText: The grill is great.  Unfortunately the kid didn’t have a lid hook so I had to go back to Home Depot and get a different lid.  Otherwise it’s great
Results.Title: It’s great

Results.ReviewText: I have had 3 of these over the last 15 years.  First one I replaced the inside grate after 4 years (way longer than any gas grill).  Then I saw a new shiny one after 8 years and let it go.  The second only lasted 4 years because it was thrown during a storm (the circle became oval and not Weber's fault).  Needless to say, they last forever and I am super happy to have a green new shiny one!
Results.Title: It never changes.  And that is AWESOME!!!

Results.ReviewText:
Quality construction.  My 1st kettle-type grill, so a slight learning curve for me.  I do miss the convenience of a hinged lid, as I find the hanging clip to be a bit awkward.  Absolutely no complaints otherwise.

As for cooking: Excellent results so far - Getting better each time.  I look forward to years of quality grilling.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle Grill Experience

Results.ReviewText: The new grill replaced a 21 year old Weber original 22" grill. Many improvements. The handle on top is so much better. The thermometer is a great addition, very helpful. I think the trap underneath is the best improvement. So easy to clean up. I use my Weber 2 or 3 times a week all year long. Love cooking with a Weber charcoal grill. Had a gas grill built in ground at my old house and will never go back.
Results.Title: Weber Rocks!

Results.ReviewText: Will only Grill with Weber! Top performance grills! I just hope Weber never goes cheap on us.
Results.Title: Weber 22” Kettle

Results.ReviewText: I love the ease of using this Charcoal grill, the installation process was rather easy and the product itself has worked terrific. With the basket underneath to catch all used soot/briquet remnants clean up is also a breeze which in the past was the largest annoyance. I love our grill.
Results.Title: Delivers on quality

Results.ReviewText: Ecstatic with this purchase. Solid construction except for tube legs that feel a little on the thin side. Happy with features, namely the ash removal system, thermometer,  lid hook, grate hangers, and openings on the grilling grate. I strongly recommend purchasing the charcoal baskets for heat management and to conserve fuel. I finally upgraded from having the “Smokey Joe” for 15 years. Weber has  excellent customer service. I also recommend buying the cover to protect from weather/UV.
Results.Title: Brand loyalty pays off

Results.ReviewText: I cook on this kettle almost daily. I use briquettes and lump depending on what I’m cooking. I noticed I have to keep the lid cracked to get real high temps. Wish the kettle had a second intake vent and another exhaust vent, or offer a kit that can be installed on any kettle if you want more air flow
Results.Title: Nice kettle- could use a few upgrades

Results.ReviewText: We love the temperature gauge, features to hold utensils and the ash collector. The heavy duty  handle and lid are so much more substantial than our old Weber which we had for 20+ years. Looking forward to many years with this one! Been Weber owners for over 40 years and love the quality.
Results.Title: Replaced Our Old Weber

Results.ReviewText: Very well built, heavy duty feel! Food tastes and smells great!
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have always loved Webber grills. And this was a great gift from my parents
Results.Title: The best grill for the price.

Results.ReviewText: This is #3, I've been cooking on Weber kettles for 20 years and there is nothing better grilling or smoking.
Results.Title: Does it all

ClientResponses.Response: Hi! Thank you for being a long time Weber fan! We greatly appreciate your feedback regarding the Original Kettle Premium. Grilling with charcoal takes some getting use to. We are happy to provide you with some tips on how to make it enjoyable. We have reached out via email to assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText: After cooking with gas for ever, I am still trying to master the charcoal method. Way too many steps and I am already thinking of replacing with another gas model. This grill is meant to be a bridge to a larger, more sustainable model, but it is not for me.
Results.Title: Too much hassle

Results.ReviewText: The kettle is a lower cost option than big stick burners or pellet grills that still gives you the opportunity to cook amazing food in a variety of different ways.
Results.Title: The classic!

Results.ReviewText: Great value. I actually own a 24” kamado ceramic grill (not the KJ) and prefer my Weber premium over it. The Weber seems to have more surface area over the kamado (the tiered racks on the kamado are impractical to use in my opinion), more accessories are available for it, it’s more versatile and way easier to maintain (the one-touch cleaning system is genius), and I can use it at extremely high temps and don’t have to deal with leaky gaskets every so often (my kamado fiber gasket peeled off the lid a year after buying it). I just wish the lid on the Weber sealed a bit better (i.e. the tolerances were a bit tighter).
Results.Title: Great grill for the price

Results.ReviewText:
Cooks great, looks great. I love the thermometer on the lid and the hook on the lid so I don't have to put it on the ground.

I wish there was a heat resistant handle on the top vent so I could adjust it without gloves. I also with the grill was a little bit taller. I have to bend a bit more than comfortable to use the grill. The "shelf" on the bottom is too small to be much use.
Results.Title: Very happy with this grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber in 20 yrs and all still work as well as the day I bought them. You cannot go wrong with a Weber kettle. A brand that you can trust, and one that stands by their products with excellent customer support.
Results.Title: Excellent product

Results.ReviewText: It is easy to use and built better than all the competitors
Results.Title: Perfect Grill

Results.ReviewText: It’s a wonderful return to the real taste of barbecue.
Results.Title: Simply Barbecue

Results.ReviewText: Very versatile,  it was a great Birthday gift.  Weber has a very informative website for grilling tips.
Results.Title: Love my new grill!

Results.ReviewText: Where to start? I like the side openings on the grill grates, makes it so easy to add more coal or wood chips for a long cook. I really like the ash pan at the bottom, clean up is a breeze. This is a wonderful grill and I think I'll be enjoying it for years to come. Well built, well thought out design.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText: With these grills a little charcoal goes a long way
Results.Title: Awesome versatile grill

14402001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14402001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
